title: On the phone
instructions: Sara ve Tom telefonda buluşma planlıyor. Kısa bir diyalog; gün, yer ve buluşma noktasına dikkat et.

script.speaker: sara
script.text: Hi Tom, it's Sara. Are you free on Friday?

script.speaker: tom
script.text: Friday? Sorry, I work on Friday. What about Saturday?

script.speaker: sara
script.text: Saturday is fine. Let's go to the new pizza restaurant.

script.speaker: sara
script.text: Let's meet at seven, outside the cinema.

questions.prompt: Why can't Tom meet on Friday?
questions.feedback: Tom cuma günü çalışıyor (I work on Friday).

questions.prompt: When are they going to meet?
questions.feedback: Sara cumayı önerir ama Tom çalışıyor. Cumartesinde anlaşıyorlar.

questions.prompt: Where are they going to eat?
questions.evidence: Let's go to the new pizza restaurant.

questions.prompt: Where are they going to meet?
questions.feedback: Yemek restoranda ama buluşma noktası sinemanın önü (outside the cinema).
questions.evidence: Let's meet at seven, outside the cinema.
